metadata.question: Was there snow present in the Northern Tablelands in New South Wales, Australia on August 2, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Northern Tablelands, New South Wales, Australia (approximately -30.5°S, 151.5°E) - Date: August 2, 2025 (single day) - Collections: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution) for NDWI/NDSI snow detection, or MODIS Terra/Aqua Snow Cover products - Will use Sentinel-2 first, then try MODIS if no data 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds since we're looking for snow - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - Snow detection: NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) - NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates snow 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (B: No snow) from Null/Error (C1/C2/C3): - C1: No images available for Aug 2, 2025 - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked (clouds) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - B: Valid calculation, NDSI < 0.4 (no snow) - A: Valid calculation, NDSI > 0.4 (snow present) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const northernTablelands = ee.Geometry.Point([151.5, -30.5]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius const targetDate = '2025-08-02'; const startDate = '2025-08-01'; const endDate = '2025-08-03'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check - Try Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(northernTablelands) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); let collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try MODIS Terra Snow Cover as fallback collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(northernTablelands) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No satellite data available for August 2, 2025'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Use MODIS snow cover data const image = collection.first(); const snowCover = image.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const stats = await snowCover.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernTablelands, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; const meanSnow = stats.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; if (!pixelCount || pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}, Mean NDSI: ${meanSnow ? meanSnow.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); if (meanSnow === null || meanSnow === undefined || isNaN(meanSnow)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // MODIS NDSI_Snow_Cover: 0-100 scale, >10 indicates snow if (meanSnow > 10) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } return; } // 3. Process Sentinel-2 data const masked = collection.map(maskS2clouds); const image = masked.first(); // 4. Calculate NDSI for snow detection const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); const stats = await ndsi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: northernTablelands, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.NDSI_count; const meanNDSI = stats.NDSI_mean; if (!pixelCount || pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}, Mean NDSI: ${meanNDSI ? meanNDSI.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanNDSI === null || meanNDSI === undefined || isNaN(meanNDSI)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates snow presence if (meanNDSI > 0.4) { console.log('Snow detected (NDSI > 0.4)'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No snow detected (NDSI <= 0.4)'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
